_comment: Model registry for run_eval.py --models. Credentials come from env vars; a model with no credential is skipped, never faked. mode=batch-recall means the prediction is a one-shot cached recall and is NOT comparable to mode=api (per-point queries).

models.label: hy3
models.note: needs a WorkBuddy-internal base url; export HY3_BASE_URL and HY3_API_KEY

models.label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
models.note: official current model string is 'deepseek-flash'; 'deepseek-v4-flash' is a compat alias that routes to it

models.label: DeepSeek V4.1 Pro
models.caveat: V4.1-Pro has NOT launched. V4-Pro was retired 2026-09-14 and all deepseek-v4-pro requests now route to V4.1-Flash at Flash rates. Until V4.1-Pro ships, this row is the same model as deepseek-v4.1-flash.
